heading: INT. MINIVAN - PARKED AT AUTOMATIC CAR WASH - DAY

units.text: INT. MINIVAN - PARKED AT AUTOMATIC CAR WASH - DAY
A cramped, crumb-strewn van with a cracked windshield and a bumper sticker reading "MY OTHER CAR IS ALSO THIS."
Sunlight bounces off foam outside.
ANSELMO ROJAS, 40s, in a wrinkled polo, grips the wheel.
HUI-MIN CHENG-ROJAS, 40s, in the passenger seat, juggles a grocery bag and a sippy cup.
In the second row, ISAAC, 10, plays a handheld game, and NOOR, 7, hugs a stuffed giraffe.
In the way back, GRANDMA FUMIKO, 80s, in a floral blouse, folds a paper crane.
Strapped into a car seat beside her, baby TUCK, 1, chews a rubber pretzel.
Okay! Windows up! Doors locked! Nobody touch anything!
units.name: ANSELMO

units.text: I'm not touching anything.
units.name: ISAAC

units.text: I'm touching the giraffe.
units.name: NOOR

units.text: Noor, that's allowed.
units.name: HUI-MIN

units.text: Look, little one. The soap is coming.
units.name: GRANDMA FUMIKO

units.text: Ba!
units.name: TUCK

units.text: The van rolls forward.
Foam slaps the windshield.
Brushes begin to thump along the sides.
We're fine. We're fine. We're fine.
units.name: ANSELMO

units.text: Anselmo, you have driven through a car wash before.
units.name: HUI-MIN

units.text: Not with her.
units.name: ANSELMO

units.text: He glances in the mirror at Grandma Fumiko, who folds another crane, serene.
